image_description: A modern outdoor staircase featuring a sleek metal bannister system. The handrail is a continuous, polished metal tube running diagonally down the stairs. It is supported by vertical metal posts (balusters) and a lower horizontal rail. The structure includes a landing area with a continuation of the railing. The background shows a concrete wall, grass, and trees.
